integrity: The Nijenhuis equations, deformation maps, automorphism group, finite-field counts, rank profiles, and orbit normal forms are reconstructed directly; finite enumeration is replay evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the parity-preserving Nijenhuis definition used for Hom-Lie antialgebras.
It treats Example 2.6 rather than all Hom-Lie antialgebras.
Characteristic two is excluded; finite-field conjugacy formulas are for odd fields.
title: Twist resonance in Nijenhuis operators on Zhang–Zhang Example 2.6
